results.title: Hindi Ito Marites: Are Filipinos losing trust in news media?
results.content: The Philippines saw the biggest decline in trust in news from 2025 to 2026

results.title: Trump announces ‘biggest trade deal’ between Philippines, US
results.content: Trump shares the supposed highlight of his brief state visit to the Philippines but gives no details. Malacañang says both sides reached an understanding on areas of economic cooperation, but does not mention a trade deal.
